architecture_trace.pipeline: claim text -> _extract_factors() [factor_normalizer.extract_known_factors_from_text + literal record.factors] -> _extract_edges()/_llm_edges() [len(factors)<2 early-return gate] -> relation_grammar.extract_relation_candidates() [clause segmentation, mention-span finding, causal-verb pattern matching, direction guard via plausible_causal_direction/CAUSAL_RANK] -> assertion_status_for() [negation/conditional classification] -> _edge() dict -> graph_builder.py (local-edge lineage/qualification) -> activation_scorer_v2.py (local_structure_support component, qualifying_local_edge_count, assertion_status != negated gate)
architecture_trace.factor_alias_authority: comqutor_alpha.structure_engine.factor_normalizer.FACTOR_ALIASES (literal substrings) -- now supplemented (additively) by the new FACTOR_ALIAS_PATTERNS (regex-based, generic phrase forms)
architecture_trace.causal_relation_authority: comqutor_alpha.structure_engine.relation_grammar -- CAUSAL_RANK/plausible_causal_direction (direction admissibility), FORWARD_CAUSAL_VERBS/FORWARD_TRANSITIVE_CAUSAL_PATTERN ('trigger' already present, unmodified), GROWTH_FACTORS/RISK_FACTORS sets (Revenue Growth/Valuation Risk already members, unmodified)
architecture_trace.negation_handling_preexisting: NEGATED_RELATION_PATTERN (relation_grammar.py) scoped to the clause-local 'bridge' text; analyze_claim_semantics().negated (claim_semantics.py) computed over the full claim text as an additional OR-condition in assertion_status_for()
architecture_trace.clause_segmentation_preexisting: relation_grammar._split_clauses() -- splits on ,.;: and but/however/although/while/whereas/yet -- already provides clause-local negation scoping for the bridge-based check
architecture_trace.edge_dedupe: extract_structures_from_records() dedupes on (source, target, edge_type, source_record_id) tuple key -- unmodified
architecture_trace.direction_determination: _resolve_forward()/_resolve_reverse() (nearest-left/nearest-right mention resolution) plus plausible_causal_direction()'s CAUSAL_RANK comparison -- unmodified; Revenue Growth (rank 3) -> Valuation Risk (rank 3) is an admissible equal-rank pair under the existing rule
architecture_trace.confidence_condition_representation: assertion_status in {asserted, conditional, negated, mixed, unknown}; relation_confidence()/relation_reason() derive confidence/reason text from (edge_type, assertion_status) -- unmodified

clause_boundary_safety.note: A pre-existing, out-of-scope architectural nuance was observed during tracing: assertion_status_for()'s OR-fallback to analyze_claim_semantics(full_claim_text).negated is computed over the WHOLE claim, not clause-scoped, unlike the bridge-based NEGATED_RELATION_PATTERN check. This could, in principle, over-suppress (mark 'negated') a genuinely-asserted relation in an unrelated clause of a mixed sentence -- a CONSERVATIVE-direction risk (never a false-positive-creation risk), and not exercised by any required test case in this task. Reported for completeness; not modified, per this task's narrow scope.
